<!-- hermes-sweeper:verdict=close reason=implemented_on_main confidence=high -->
Thanks for checking the contribution path before preparing a PR. This automated hermes-sweeper review found that current main already documents the recommended path for this exact kind of community platform adapter.

- The recommended route is a standalone platform plugin in `~/.hermes/plugins/`, rather than a core integration: `website/docs/developer-guide/adding-platform-adapters.md:9-13,31-39`.
- The guide covers the adapter contract, `ctx.register_platform()` registration, configuration and authorization hooks, multi-profile token locks, and reference implementations: `website/docs/developer-guide/adding-platform-adapters.md:21-29,117-147,174-199,455-457`.
- The guide was introduced in commit `289d2745afd2dc9ae881d0b873371bfb0eb7b228` (`docs: add platform adapter developer guide + WeCom Callback docs`).

Please use that plugin path and its referenced IRC/Teams/Google Chat/LINE examples when preparing the adapter; richer capabilities can remain outside the adapter as described in the issue.
